C08-M04-L06-F1.title: What a proxy logs for HTTPS, without and with TLS inspection
C08-M04-L06-F1.caption: The fields an analyst gets from an uninspected CONNECT tunnel compared with an inspected HTTPS request.
C08-M04-L06-F1.alt: Comparison of two columns separated by 'vs'. Left, Without TLS inspection: CONNECT cdn-telemetry-sync.example:443; host and port only, no path, no query; tunnel totals, bytes each way, duration; inner HTTP status and method unseen; timing and rarity still visible. Right, With TLS inspection: full URL /api/v2/ping; method, status, content type; per-request bytes out and in; user agent and referer; malware and DLP scanning possible.

columns.title: Without TLS inspection
items: Host and port only: no path, no query
Tunnel totals: bytes each way, duration
Inner HTTP status and method unseen

C08-M04-L06-F1.note: Inspection adds paths and content controls; rarity, rhythm and volume survive without it.
